motion.purpose: Every entrance and pulse on the stage: rise, toast-in, summon-rise, banner, mic-pulse.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Prediction card enters from 24px below at 97% scale.

motion.name: summon-rise
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: guide rises from 60vh at 60% scale with a 4% overshoot at 60%.

motion.name: sparkle
motion.purpose: Fourteen eight-point sparkles burst outward on --dx/--dy and fade.

motion.name: spell-burst
motion.purpose: Sunshine radial pool scales 0.2 to 1.6 and fades.

motion.name: banner
motion.purpose: Spell banner pops to 105%, holds, drifts up 10px and fades.

motion.name: mic-pulse
motion.purpose: Sunshine ring breathes 94% to 110% and fades; 1.4s on the speaking friend.

motion.name: chip-pulse

motion.name: dot
motion.purpose: Three building dots bounce 8px with 150ms stagger.

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: Character eyes close to 8% at the 96% mark; right eye 50ms late.

motion.name: mouth

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.css: .ds-stage { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 20px; background: #243e36; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; min-height: 52px; padding: 7px 16px 7px 14px; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff9eef2; color: #243e36; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -12px #000b; } .ds-chip strong { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 800 17px/1.1 Baloo, sans-serif; } .ds-chip strong::before { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #245e4e; } .ds-chip[data-state='connected'] strong::before { background: #f7d76e; animation: ds-chip-pulse 1.6s ease-out infinite; } .ds-chip[data-state='building'] strong::before { background: #f9ceb0; } .ds-chip[data-state='error'] strong::before { background: #c7572b; } .ds-chip small { font: 600 12px/1.1 Nunito, sans-serif; color: #51675c; } @keyframes ds-chip-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 #f7d76e99; } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 9px #f7d76e00; } }

components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; place-items: end; padding: 24px; background: #243e36; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-toast { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: start; width: min(380px, 80vw); padding: 14px 14px 16px; border-radius: 22px; background: #fff9ee; color: #243e36; box-shadow: 0 24px 50px -22px #000d; animation: ds-toast-in 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); font-family: Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-toast .badge { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #f7d76e; color: #243e36; } .ds-toast .badge svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; } .ds-toast h2 { margin: 0; font: 800 22px/1.12 Baloo, sans-serif; } .ds-toast p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-toast p + p { color: #51675c; } .ds-toast .close { cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #d5e7c9; color: #243e36; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-toast .close svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-toast .close:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #f7d76e; outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { transform: translateY(40px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }

components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; height: 132px; padding: 0 20px 12px; background: #243e36; border-top: 1px solid #fff9ee22; border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px; } .ds-friend { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 84px; padding: 6px 6px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; background: transparent; color: #fff9eec9; font: 700 14px/1.1 Nunito, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms, color 220ms; } .ds-friend:hover { background: #fff9ee12; } .ds-friend .art { position: relative; width: 68px; height: 68px; transition: transform 220ms; } .ds-friend .art svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 12px #0008); } .ds-friend .ring { position: absolute; inset: -6px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #f7d76e; opacity: 0; } .ds-friend.is-active { color: #fff9ee; } .ds-friend.is-active .art { width: 96px; height: 96px; transform: translateY(-6px); } .ds-friend.is-active .ring { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-friend.is-active.is-speaking .ring { opacity: 1; animation: ds-mic-pulse 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite; } .ds-friend:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #f7d76e; outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-mic-pulse { 0% { transform: scale(0.94); opacity: 0.9; } 70%, 100% { transform: scale(1.1); opacity: 0; } }

components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; place-items: start end; padding: 24px; background: #243e36; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-lab { display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 300px; padding: 14px 14px 14px 16px; border-radius: 22px; background: #fff9eef0; color: #243e36; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -20px #000c; font-family: Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-lab .head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; } .ds-lab h2 { margin: 0; font: 800 22px/1.12 Baloo, sans-serif; } .ds-lab .head button { cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #d5e7c9; color: #243e36; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-lab .head button svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-lab .variable { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 6px 10px; padding: 12px 2px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3d8c3; } .ds-lab .variable label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 800 15px/1.2 Baloo, sans-serif; } .ds-lab .variable output { font: 700 15px/1.2 Nunito, sans-serif; color: #245e4e; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-lab .num { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; align-self: center; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 2px solid #d6decb; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #245e4e; font: 800 16px/1 Baloo, sans-serif; } .ds-lab input[type='range'] { grid-column: 1 / -1; min-height: 44px; width: 100%; margin: 0; accent-color: #245e4e; } .ds-lab .challenge { margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; color: #51675c; } .ds-lab .challenge.active { background: #f7d76e; color: #243e36; } .ds-lab .challenge strong { display: block; font: 800 17px/1.3 Baloo, sans-serif; } .ds-lab button:focus-visible, .ds-lab input:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #f7d76e; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: The Theatre Built From the Mark
narrative.overview:
Just Imagine has one palette and two rooms. The parent room is a calm, paper-coloured page: warm cream ground (#fff9ee), deep green foreground (#243e36), forest actions (#245e4e), muted leaf, ochre and clay accents. Locally hosted Baloo provides soft rounded headings; Nunito provides readable body copy. The landing composition pairs a large question with an abstract geometric play window. It makes no claim that geometric placeholders are final illustration.

The child room is the same palette turned inside out. The Studio is a stage, not a page: the forest green that is ink on the parent side becomes the wings and floor, and the cream that is ground on the parent side becomes the pills, captions and sheets that float at the stage edges. The Dream Launch mark (forest tile, cream cloud, peach arc, sunshine star) supplies the whole stage vocabulary: forest for the house, cream for anything you can touch, peach for warmth, sunshine for anything live. Six authored SVG characters carry the mark's round geometry (big eyes, a mouth driven by the voice level, a blink every few seconds) and stand in for external Rive assets with identical mounting.

The child and parent worlds share typography and semantic colors. Motion duration is a token and becomes zero with reduced-motion preferences. Physics remains interactive. Parent forms and all actionable child controls retain visible keyboard focus. Browser selection, progress meters and range inputs use the same palette.
keyCharacteristics: One palette, inverted between rooms: cream page with forest ink for parents; forest stage with cream pills for children.
Baloo for anything that names (headings, dial values, chip titles, answer buttons); Nunito for anything that explains (body, captions, pill labels).
Sunshine (#f7d76e) means live: mic ring, speaking friend's ring, pressed pill, connected dot, active challenge, spell banner.
Fully rounded pills on the stage; 10 to 16 px corners in the parent room.
Soft offset shadows cast toward the floor; no borders on the stage, quiet 1 px dividers in the parent room.
One authored motion moment (the summon rise with sparkles); everything else is a short state transition or a breathing pulse.

rules.name: The Sunshine-Means-Live Rule
rules.body: Yellow (#f7d76e) is reserved for things that are listening, speaking, pressed, connected, or just happened. It never decorates a resting surface. A yellow element the child cannot act on or that is not currently happening is a defect.

rules.name: The Inverted Rooms Rule
rules.body: Forest ink and cream ground are the same two colours in both rooms; the parent room sets ink on cream and the stage sets cream on ink. Never introduce a third page colour to tell the rooms apart.

rules.name: The Quiet Chrome Rule
rules.body: On the stage, controls that leave or reset (home, gallery, reset) are translucent cream at 15% on forest; controls that act in the world (captions, finish, answers) are opaque cream or a full accent. A child should be able to tell "exit" from "play" by weight alone.

rules.name: The Naming Face Rule
rules.body: Baloo appears wherever a thing is named or chosen: headings, dial values, variable names, answer buttons, keypad digits, the spell banner. Nunito appears wherever a thing is explained: body, captions, pill labels, hints. A Baloo sentence or a Nunito heading is a defect.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels anywhere. Small labels get Baloo weight and a darker colour, not tracking or capitals.

rules.name: The Stage-Not-Page Rule
rules.body: The Studio never scrolls and never shows a heading over the world. The world fills the viewport and everything else floats at the edges in pills.

rules.name: The Beside-Not-Over Rule
rules.body: The lab column and the cast strip share the viewport with the world; they never cover it. Only transient moments (prediction, summon, spell, toast) may overlay the world, and each one is dismissed by a child's answer or by time.

rules.name: The Floor Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows always fall downward with negative spread and never spread outward evenly. A centred glow, a hard offset, or a coloured halo on a resting surface is a defect; the only radial light pools are the cream spotlight behind the listening friend and the sunshine burst of a spell, and both are moments, not surfaces.

rules.name: The Line-Or-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The parent room separates with lines and never with shadows on content; the stage separates with shadows and never with lines. The single exception is the 1 px cream line at 13% along the top of the cast strip.

dos: Do keep the two rooms on the same two colours: ink on cream for parents, cream on ink for the stage.
Do use sunshine (#f7d76e) only for what is live, pressed or just happened, and peach (#f9ceb0) for warmth and the softer option.
Do use Baloo 800 for anything named or chosen and Nunito for anything explained; keep everything sentence case.
Do make stage controls full pills with floor shadows (negative spread, black at low alpha) and no borders; keep parent controls at 10 to 16 px corners with 1 px lines.

Do keep targets at 44 px in the parent room, 52 px for stage pills and 64 px for the child's answers and keypad keys; every actionable control keeps a visible focus ring (ochre on cream, sunshine on forest).
Do let the world fill the viewport in the Studio with chrome floating at a 16 px edge and the lab beside the world, never over it.
Do ease every entrance with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), run loops as slow breathing pulses, and zero all of it under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do mount character art in a fixed square slot so authored SVG and Rive swap without layout change.
donts: Don't put a heading, a card frame or a scrolling column over or around the world in the Studio.
Don't use yellow on a resting surface, or any gradient fill on a surface; the only gradients are the listening spotlight and the spell burst.
Don't add uppercase labels, letter-spaced eyebrows or kicker lines; small labels get Baloo weight and a darker colour instead.
Don't use hard offset shadows, even glows or coloured halos on resting elements.
Don't add a third accent or a new page colour to distinguish screens; tonal steps of cream and forest do that.
Don't present the geometric landing window or the authored SVG cast as finished illustration; the final painted and Rive assets are external.
Don't replace inline SVG icons with glyph fonts or emoji in chrome.
